story.title: Meesho Posts Rs 166 Crore Loss in Q4 FY26 Despite 47% Revenue Jump and 264 Million Active Users
story.summary: Meesho reported a 47% year-on-year revenue increase in Q4 FY26, supported by 264 million annual transacting users and a 45% rise in order volumes, even as average order values dipped slightly. Despite strong top-line growth, the company remained loss-making with a Rs 166 crore deficit for the quarter, reflecting continued investment in logistics and platform expansion. Meesho's scale makes it one of the largest e-commerce platforms serving price-sensitive consumers in Tier 2 and Tier 3 Indian cities.
